2. The facts of the case, in brief, are that the plaintiffs filed Title Suit No. 299 of 1989 in the Additional Court of Assistant Judge, Kushtia, for declaration of title in respect of the land mentioned in schedule 'Ka' to the plaint, for recovery of possession in respect of the land shown in schedule `Kha' and for confirmation of possession in respect of the land in schedule `Ga'. It was stated in the plaint, inter alia, that the land of Khatian Nos. 350 and 151 measured 1.21 acres of which 8 annas belonged to Entaz Malitha and Jahaj Malitha who were in possession of 0.60½ acre of land. They transferred 0.19½ acre from that land. Entaz Malitha died leaving Jahaj, Malitha as his heir. The plaintiffs as heirs of Jahaj Malitha acquired interest, title and possession in 0.41 acre of land. Defendant Nos. 1 and 2 dispossessed the plaintiffs in March 1974 from 5¼ decimals of land of plot No. 913 and erected structures thereon. The plaintiffs requested the defendants to vacate the land from which they had dispossessed them, but the defendants did not pay any heed to that request. The said 0.41 acre of land has been wrongly recorded in the name of the mother of defendant No. 1 and others in SA Khatian No. 1788. Hence, the plaintiffs filed the suit. 

 12. We find from the judgment of the trial Court that it was observed that the plaintiffs' witnesses admitted that the defendants have been living in the suit plot by constructing homestead since long before March, 1974. Moreover, the SA khatian submitted by the plaintiffs, shows that plot No. 913 is recorded as a homestead which proves that the suit plot was homestead of the defendants before the SA record was prepared. We find from the evidence that PW I stated that his father and uncles were dispossessed by defendant Nos. 1 and 2, 14½ years prior to his deposition in Court on 22-11-1988. That would mean that the dispossession took place in or around 1973. According to PW 1 he requested the defendants on 1-3-1979 to vacate the land from which the plaintiffs had been dispossessed. According to the evidence of PW 2 the dispossession took place in about 1974, but his father/uncles did not file any suit against Noorjahan (defendant No. 1). According to PW 3 also Noorjahan's house is on the suit land, i.e. on 5¼ decimals of land in plot No. 913 since about 1974.
